title: Regional hybrid-electric fixed-wing reference mission template

reference_range.interpretation: Intentionally unspecified until a target route, aircraft class, payload, reserve policy, and baseline are selected.

open_questions: Select the regional aircraft class and a matched conventional reference aircraft.
Define passenger, crew, baggage, cargo payload, and centre-of-gravity envelopes.
Select route distance, cruise altitude, speed, climb profile, and alternate airport.
Choose the operating jurisdiction and applicable reserve and diversion requirements.
Specify fuel type, engine/generator map, battery power/energy requirements, and hybrid power-split policy.
Model takeoff, climb, cruise, go-around, descent, landing, and required failure cases separately.
Define the thermal management system and allowable degraded-cooling operating envelope.
Define fuel, battery, generator, inverter, motor, and propulsor measurement boundaries.
Establish lifecycle emissions, fuel-burn, turnaround, maintenance, and dispatch availability baselines.

provenance.source_name: NASA, GE Aerospace Work Enables Hybrid-Electric Flight Demonstration
provenance.source_claim: NASA reported a megawatt-class hybrid-electric system flight demonstration on a modified Saab 340B in July 2026. This is a technology reference, not a mission specification or a claim that the reference aircraft meets this template.
